sentences.en: Algeria needs to develop a more self-sufficient economy.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要发展一个更加自给自足的经济。

sentences.en: Algeria hopes to become economically self-sufficient some day.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚希望有一天能够实现经济上的自给自足。

sentences.en: We take pride in being self-sufficient. We don't want a permanent handout.
sentences.zh: 我们以自给自足为荣。我们不想依赖永久性的救济。

senses.zh: 自足的，极为自负的，傲慢的,自给,自给自足
